scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; npm run dev"
scripts.prebuild: npm run test:contract && npm run audit:metrics
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:contract && npm run audit:metrics && npm run test
